protocol: Unchanged BM25 tokenization, retrieval and exact title mention boost transferred after Hotpot test scores were seen, before any MuSiQue support labels are accessed.
source: StonyBrookNLP MuSiQue answerable dev original CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/stonybrooknlp/musique, mirror dgslibisey/MuSiQue matching other mirrors SHA256
limits: New dataset has 20 original provided candidate Wikipedia paragraphs and gold 2–4-hop chains, unlike Hotpot ten/2-hop
Title-first approximate method uses first 400 text characters because MuSiQue has paragraph text string not sentence list; title/full/linked main methods unchanged
No semantic parsing or DRS model; comparison only shows cross-dataset transfer of untrained source-link retrieval
